# mcp-server-il-benefits

> Thin MCP server and agent skill for Israeli shoppers. The user says "I'm at store X"; the agent asks an existing benefits aggregator (GotCashback) live, once per question, and answers with what to do before paying (cashback link, discounted gift card), with the source and link. No scraping, no stored data, never buys anything.

- Homepage: https://github.com/ofershap/mcp-server-il-benefits
- License: MIT
- Spec: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 (https://agent-plugins.org)
- Transport: MCP stdio via npx

## Install

Use npx package `mcp-server-il-benefits` with stdio transport (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code).

## Tools

- best_way_to_pay: store (Hebrew or English), optional country, basket amount, channel. Live lookup, ranked options with the user's providers first, how_to_use, link, source attribution.
- list_sources: connected sources and their terms page.
- wallet_get, wallet_set: local list of provider names the user uses.

## Coverage

Shipped source: GotCashback (terms section 5 welcomes AI agents). Covers cashback portals and discounted gift cards, a few hundred Israeli stores. It does not cover credit card or club benefits per store: those databases do not permit automated access. See DATA_SOURCES.md.

## FAQ

Q: Which credit card should I use at a store in Israel?
A: This tool does not know card or club benefits. It finds cashback and discounted gift cards for the store and says what to do before paying.

Q: Does it scrape?
A: No. One call per question to GotCashback's public MCP endpoint, with attribution and no caching.

Q: Can it buy or generate codes?
A: No. It returns steps and links only.

Q: Is personal data stored?
A: Only a local list of provider names. No card numbers or balances.
